notes_for_editor: Story is 93 words, below the 120-word floor, because the sources say no more. The Eastern US Lookouts page spells the name Miccosukee; the map database spells it Micosukee. The two are assumed to be the same tower, which is not confirmed. No register entry, agency, builder, date, height, owner or status was found. Two web searches and two page reads used. Consider dropping the story or holding it until a source turns up.
